description: Use this when someone asks what big traders or whales are buying or selling right now in a coin or the market. The latest large crypto market orders (whale trades) caught as they trade on Binance, OKX, Gate, Bybit and Hyperliquid in sixty major coins, with value, average price and side, plus how much large buying and large selling each coin saw in the last 24 hours. Filter by coin and by smallest order in dollars. Answers "what are whales buying or selling right now" and "any large BTC orders in the last hour". Live market data, not advice.
